items.source: Defaults to true, leading to an exception being thrown if the attribute is missing in the session or there is no session. Switch this to false if you prefer a null or Java 8 java.util.Optional if the attribute doesn't exist.
items.translation: 默认为 `true`，如果会话中缺少该属性或没有会话，则会抛出异常。如果您更希望在属性不存在时返回 `null` 或 Java 8 的 `java.util.Optional`，请将其切换为 `false`。

items.source: For use cases that require adding or removing session attributes consider injecting org.springframework.web.context.request.WebRequest or jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession into the controller method.
items.translation: 对于需要添加或删除会话属性的用例，考虑将 `org.springframework.web.context.request.WebRequest` 或 `jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession` 注入到控制器方法中。

items.source: For temporary storage of model attributes in the session as part of the workflow for a controller, consider using SessionAttributes instead.
items.translation: 作为控制器工作流的一部分，若要临时存储模型属性到会话中，请考虑使用 `SessionAttributes`。

items.source:
The main motivation is to provide convenient access to existing, permanent
session attributes (for example, user authentication object) with an optional/required
check and a cast to the target method parameter type.
items.translation: 主要动机是提供对现有、永久的会话属性（例如用户认证对象）的便捷访问，并包含可选或必需的检查以及向目标方法参数类型的转换。

items.source: The default name is inferred from the method parameter name.
items.translation: 默认名称是从方法参数名推断出来的。

items.source: The name of the session attribute to bind to.
items.translation: 要绑定的会话属性名称。

items.source: Whether the session attribute is required.
